summary: Iteration 50 complete: backend contact/video regression passed and frontend landing redesign regression passed across desktop/mobile breakpoints with anchor, ROI, tabs, links, cookie-removal, responsive overflow, and mobile-menu behavior checks.
action_items: No functional defects found in this scope.
Optional: run one manual UI contact success submission in a future cycle only if business wants explicit UI success-panel evidence separate from API-level submission.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~13k lines), violating maintainability guidance; split by domains/routes to reduce risk and improve testability.
JWT secret currently has an insecure fallback default in code (os.environ.get with literal). Environment-only fail-fast secret is recommended for production hardening.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; no auth flow execution required for this scope.
seed_data_creation: Created one QA-labelled public contact lead via API test: qa.iter50.<timestamp>@example.com (real endpoint call).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend checks executed on public URL from frontend/.env. Verified: no cookie notice/banner on /, /login, /contact, /privacy-policy after >1s; no localStorage cookieConsent key; all 5 feature tabs update src/alt/caption and keyboard Arrow/Home/End works; hero has no app-dashboard image while features preview defaults to app-dashboard; responsive widths 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 have no horizontal overflow; mobile menu aria-expanded toggles and closes on link/Escape; mobile tabs are vertical and phones are 2-column grid; pricing values exactly €6.50 and €8.50 with no €179; ROI default values and plan-cost toggle values match expected; video poster/source unchanged and media reachable. Browser test intentionally included MOCKED network error for /api/public/contact to validate friendly error + submit recovery.
rca of the issue: No functional regression issue reproduced in tested scope. The only browser console error captured (net::ERR_FAILED) was intentionally triggered by MOCKED network abort during contact-form error-path validation.
